subject: Re: Northbridge Health — Security questionnaire follow-up (SOC 2 + Security FAQ)
body:
From: Sarah Patel <sarah.patel@northbridgehealth.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, Jan 14, 2026 at 4:08 PM
Subject: Northbridge Health — Security questionnaire follow-up

Hi Avery,

Thanks again for your team’s quick turnaround on the security questionnaire.

As a next step, our InfoSec reviewer is requesting:
1) Your SOC 2 Type II report (or the latest available)
2) The updated Security FAQ PDF you referenced on today’s call

If there’s an NDA requirement for the SOC 2 report, let me know what you need from us (we can use our standard mutual NDA).

Timing-wise, we’re trying to complete our security review by next Wednesday (1/21) to stay on track for procurement.

Thank you,
Sarah

Sarah Patel
Security & Risk | Northbridge Health
sarah.patel@northbridgehealth.com

From: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sarah Patel <sarah.patel@northbridgehealth.com>
Date: Wed, Jan 14, 2026 at 4:27 PM
Subject: Re: Northbridge Health — Security questionnaire follow-up

Hi Sarah,

Absolutely — attaching our latest Enterprise Security FAQ PDF.

Attachment:
- Redwood-Inference-Enterprise-Security-FAQ-v2.pdf (PDF)

For the SOC 2 Type II report: yes, we share it under NDA. I’m looping in our GRC/compliance team now to confirm the fastest path and get you access.

A couple quick questions so we don’t lose time:
- Do you already have an NDA in place with Redwood Inference, or should we use Northbridge’s standard mutual NDA?
- Who should be the recipient of the SOC 2 materials (you + anyone else on your side)?

Thanks,
Avery

Avery Johnson
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwoodinference.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>, Daniel Carter <daniel.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: (none)
Date: Wed, Jan 14, 2026 at 4:31 PM
Subject: (Internal) SOC 2 request — Northbridge Health (need NDA + report access)

Hi Olga/Daniel,

Northbridge Health is in security review and requesting SOC 2 Type II. They’re aiming to close security review by Wed 1/21.

External contact:
- Sarah Patel (Security & Risk) sarah.patel@northbridgehealth.com

Questions:
1) What’s our current SOC 2 sharing process for prospects (NDA requirements + how we provide the report)?
2) Can we provide a pen test summary as well, or should we keep this to SOC 2 only unless requested?

I already sent them the updated Security FAQ PDF.

Thanks,
Avery


---

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Daniel Carter <daniel.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, Jan 14, 2026 at 5:02 PM
Subject: Re: (Internal) SOC 2 request — Northbridge Health (need NDA + report access)

Hi Avery,

Confirmed: SOC 2 Type II report is NDA-gated.

Fastest path:
1) Execute mutual NDA (we can accept theirs, or send ours if needed).
2) Once executed, Daniel can provide the SOC 2 report via our controlled sharing mechanism (time-bounded link) and we’ll log distribution.

Please avoid sending the report as an email attachment.

On pen test: do not proactively include the full report. If they ask, we can share the pen test executive summary under NDA as well.

Also: please don’t commit to notification timelines in email—stick to “per contract” language.

Thanks,
Olga

Olga Petrov
GRC / Compliance | Redwood Inference


---

From: Daniel Carter <daniel.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, Jan 14, 2026 at 5:11 PM
Subject: Re: (Internal) SOC 2 request — Northbridge Health (need NDA + report access)

+1 to Olga.

Once NDA is executed, I can send:
- SOC 2 Type II report (PDF)
- SOC 2 cover letter / scope notes (1-pager)

If they ask about scope (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private):
- SOC 2 covers our hosted service operations and supporting corporate controls.
- Dedicated capacity is within the managed service boundary; customer config responsibilities still apply.
- Private/on-prem is a shared responsibility model with customer-managed infrastructure depending on deployment.

Avery — when you get the NDA route + recipient list, I’ll prep the share.

Daniel

Daniel Carter
Security Compliance Operations | Redwood Inference

From: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sarah Patel <sarah.patel@northbridgehealth.com>
Date: Wed, Jan 14, 2026 at 5:28 PM
Subject: Re: Northbridge Health — Security questionnaire follow-up

Hi Sarah,

Confirmed on our side: we share the SOC 2 Type II report under a mutual NDA.

Two options:
1) If you prefer, send your standard mutual NDA and we’ll review/countersign.
2) Or we can send Redwood’s mutual NDA for signature.

Once the NDA is executed, we’ll provide the SOC 2 report via a controlled sharing link (not as an email attachment) and can include a short scope summary.

To keep things moving, could you please share:
- Which NDA option you prefer (yours vs ours)
- The name/email of the signer on Northbridge’s side
- Who should receive the SOC 2 materials (you + anyone else)

Thanks,
Avery

Hi Avery,

Thanks — the FAQ was helpful.

Attached is our standard mutual NDA. Signer on our side is Legal Ops (cc’d) and I’d like to be included as a recipient for the SOC 2 materials.

Attachment:
- NorthbridgeHealth_Redwood_Mutual-NDA_v3.pdf

One question from our reviewer: does the SOC 2 report cover both your hosted offering and dedicated capacity, or only the hosted API?

Best,
Sarah

Northbridge sent their mutual NDA (attached). Can you / Legal please review and advise on signature path?

They also asked whether SOC 2 covers hosted + dedicated.

Attachment:

Avery

From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>, Daniel Carter <daniel.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, Jan 15, 2026 at 11:03 AM
Subject: Re: (Internal) NDA attached — Northbridge Health (SOC 2 sharing)

Avery — received. We can work with this form.

Olga and I will route for countersignature today/tomorrow depending on signer availability. Please set expectation externally as 1–2 business days.

On the SOC 2 scope question: keep it high-level. Don’t expand beyond what’s stated in the report. It’s fine to say the report covers Redwood’s service operations and applicable systems supporting the service; for Dedicated/Private emphasize shared responsibility and that details are described in the scope section of the report + our security documentation.

Michael

Michael Grant
Commercial Counsel | Redwood Inference

Hi Sarah (and Legal Ops),

Thanks for sending the NDA — our Legal + GRC teams are reviewing it now. Expecting countersignature within ~1–2 business days.

Re: SOC 2 scope: the SOC 2 Type II report covers Redwood Inference’s service operations and supporting systems in scope for the service. Once the NDA is executed, we’ll share the report along with a short scope note, and your reviewer can reference the report’s scope section for the authoritative detail.

As soon as we have the fully executed NDA, we’ll send the SOC 2 materials via a controlled sharing link and include you as a recipient.

Thanks,
Avery
